requiredEnvironment.LITHE_TEST_GO_PLUGIN_ARCHIVE: absolute path to the plugin ZIP matching the client platform

requiredEnvironment.LITHE_TEST_GO_SSH_HOST: OpenSSH alias of a disposable Linux host with go, gopls and dlv on the login PATH
requiredEnvironment.LITHE_REMOTE_SERVER_STAGE: absolute path to the compatible host's staged lithe-remote-server builds
